items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Chris told a fellow if we move in there, he'd get out... Did Chris know many different pieces

ctx.x: Right there. One band wouldn't move. Chris told a fellow if we move in there, he'd get out. You'd get out. So we finished our advertising right there.
With Rene, yeah? Yeah. Who won? Did anybody tell who they thought was best?

items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Gold man? [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm. One of them little bit of carnet.

ctx.x: When Chris died, Chris had with them one of them little bit of gold carnet, just about that long.
Mm-hmm. One of them little bit of carnet.
